1	"""Standalone scheduler process for Seoul city-data ingestion.
2	
3	Run independently from the API process::
4	
5	    python -m app.ingest.worker
6	    python -m app.ingest.worker --once --database-url sqlite:///local.db
7	"""
8	
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import argparse
12	import logging
13	from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
14	from dataclasses import dataclass
15	from datetime import UTC, datetime
16	from typing import Any, Literal
17	
18	from apscheduler.schedulers.blocking import BlockingScheduler
19	from sqlalchemy import Engine
20	from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, sessionmaker
21	
22	from app.clients.seoul_citydata import (
23	    SeoulCityDataClient,
24	    suppress_secret_bearing_http_logs,
25	)
26	from app.config import POLL_INTERVAL_MIN, Settings, get_settings
27	from app.database import create_db_engine
28	from app.ingest.poller import PollReport, PopulationClient, poll_once
29	from app.ingest.repository import SnapshotRepository
30	from app.scoring.engine import materialize_all
31	
32	
33	LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)
34	
35	
36	CycleStatus = Literal["running", "complete", "partial", "failed"]
37	
38	
39	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
40	class CycleReport:
41	    cycle_id: int
42	    targets: int
43	    saved: int
44	    failed: int
45	    status: CycleStatus
46	
47	
48	def run_poll_cycle(
49	    session_factory: sessionmaker[Session],
50	    *,
51	    client: PopulationClient,
52	    materializer: Callable[[Session], Any] = materialize_all,
53	    clock: Callable[[], datetime] = lambda: datetime.now(UTC),
54	) -> CycleReport:
55	    repository = SnapshotRepository(session_factory)
56	    targets = repository.load_poll_targets()
57	    cycle_id = repository.start_cycle(targets=len(targets), started_at=clock())
58	    poll_report: PollReport | None = None
59	    try:
60	        poll_report = poll_once(
61	            targets,
62	            client=client,
63	            save_snapshot=repository.save_snapshot,
64	            save_parse_failure=repository.save_parse_failure,
65	        )
66	        with session_factory() as session:
67	            materializer(session)
68	    except (Exception, KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit):
69	        # ``poll-production.yml`` gives the worker an explicit SIGINT deadline
70	        # before the GitHub job timeout.  Python turns SIGINT into
71	        # KeyboardInterrupt, which must finalize the durable cycle just like a
72	        # normal exception; otherwise /api/health reports ``running`` forever.
73	        saved = poll_report.saved if poll_report else 0
74	        failed = poll_report.failed if poll_report else len(targets)
75	        repository.finish_cycle(
76	            cycle_id,
77	            completed_at=clock(),
78	            saved=saved,
79	            failed=failed,
80	            status="failed",
81	        )
82	        raise
83	
84	    is_complete = (
85	        poll_report.targets > 0
86	        and poll_report.saved == poll_report.targets
87	        and poll_report.failed == 0
88	    )
89	    status: CycleStatus
90	    if is_complete:
91	        status = "complete"
92	    elif poll_report.saved > 0:
93	        status = "partial"
94	    else:
95	        status = "failed"
96	    repository.finish_cycle(
97	        cycle_id,
98	        completed_at=clock(),
99	        saved=poll_report.saved,
100	        failed=poll_report.failed,
101	        status=status,
102	    )
103	    return CycleReport(
104	        cycle_id=cycle_id,
105	        targets=poll_report.targets,
106	        saved=poll_report.saved,
107	        failed=poll_report.failed,
108	        status=status,
109	    )
110	
111	
112	def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
113	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run the city-data poller")
114	    parser.add_argument(
115	        "--once",
116	        action="store_true",
117	        help="run one polling cycle and exit",
118	    )
119	    parser.add_argument(
120	        "--database-url",
121	        help="override DATABASE_URL for this worker process",
122	    )
123	    return parser
124	
125	
126	def main(
127	    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
128	    *,
129	    settings_loader: Callable[[], Settings] = get_settings,
130	    client_factory: Callable[[str], PopulationClient] = SeoulCityDataClient,
131	    engine_factory: Callable[[str | None], Engine] = create_db_engine,
132	    scheduler_factory: Callable[..., Any] = BlockingScheduler,
133	) -> int:
134	    args = _parser().parse_args(argv)
135	    suppress_secret_bearing_http_logs()
136	    settings = settings_loader()
137	    if settings.seoul_api_key is None:
138	        raise SystemExit("SEOUL_API_KEY is required for the ingest worker")
139	
140	    database_url = args.database_url or settings.database_url
141	    engine = engine_factory(database_url)
142	    session_factory = sessionmaker(
143	        bind=engine,
144	        expire_on_commit=False,
145	        class_=Session,
146	    )
147	    client = client_factory(settings.seoul_api_key.get_secret_value())
148	
149	    def cycle() -> CycleReport:
150	        report = run_poll_cycle(session_factory, client=client)
151	        LOGGER.info(
152	            "Polling cycle %s: targets=%d saved=%d failed=%d",
153	            report.status,
154	            report.targets,
155	            report.saved,
156	            report.failed,
157	        )
158	        return report
159	
160	    try:
161	        if args.once:
162	            return 0 if cycle().status == "complete" else 1
163	
164	        scheduler = scheduler_factory(timezone="Asia/Seoul")
165	        scheduler.add_job(
166	            cycle,
167	            "interval",
168	            minutes=POLL_INTERVAL_MIN,
169	            coalesce=True,
170	            max_instances=1,
171	        )
172	        scheduler.start()
173	        return 0
174	    except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit):
175	        return 0
176	    finally:
177	        engine.dispose()
178	
179	
180	if __name__ == "__main__":
181	    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
182	    raise SystemExit(main())

93	def observed_at_to_utc(value: str) -> datetime:
94	    """Interpret Seoul's timezone-less ``PPLTN_TIME`` and return UTC."""

102	def _as_utc(value: datetime) -> datetime:
103	    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
104	        raise ValueError("clock must return a timezone-aware datetime")
105	    return value.astimezone(UTC)

108	def _find_forecast(
109	    payload: Any, *, area_code: str
110	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
111	    """Return the raw forecast array belonging to the parsed area record."""
112	
113	    if isinstance(payload, Mapping):
114	        if payload.get("AREA_CD") == area_code:
115	            forecast = payload.get("FCST_PPLTN", [])
116	            if isinstance(forecast, list) and all(
117	                isinstance(item, dict) for item in forecast
118	            ):
119	                return forecast
120	        for value in payload.values():
121	            found = _find_forecast(value, area_code=area_code)
122	            if found:
123	                return found
124	    elif isinstance(payload, list):
125	        for value in payload:
126	            found = _find_forecast(value, area_code=area_code)
127	            if found:
128	                return found
129	    return []

160	def poll_once(
161	    targets: Iterable[PollTarget],
162	    *,
163	    client: PopulationClient,
164	    save_snapshot: SnapshotWriter,
165	    save_parse_failure: ParseFailureWriter,
166	    clock: Callable[[], datetime] = lambda: datetime.now(UTC),
167	    sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
168	    max_retries: int = HTTP_MAX_RETRIES,
169	    retry_base_delay_seconds: float = HTTP_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_SECONDS,
170	    max_consecutive_failures: int = POLL_MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES,
171	    logger: logging.Logger = LOGGER,
172	) -> PollReport:
173	    """Poll every target once, isolating retries and failures per target.
174	
175	    ``max_retries`` counts retries after the initial request.  Backoff delays
176	    are ``base``, ``base * 2``, ... and can be replaced in tests.
177	    """
178	
179	    if max_retries < 0:
180	        raise ValueError("max_retries must be >= 0")
181	    if retry_base_delay_seconds < 0:
182	        raise ValueError("retry_base_delay_seconds must be >= 0")
183	    if max_consecutive_failures <= 0:
184	        raise ValueError("max_consecutive_failures must be > 0")
185	
186	    target_list = tuple(targets)
187	    saved = 0
188	    failed = 0
189	    consecutive_failures = 0
190	
191	    def record_target_failure(target_index: int) -> bool:
192	        """Count one failure and open the outage circuit when bounded."""
193	
194	        nonlocal consecutive_failures, failed
195	        failed += 1
196	        consecutive_failures += 1
197	        if consecutive_failures < max_consecutive_failures:
198	            return False
199	
200	        skipped = len(target_list) - target_index - 1
201	        failed += skipped
202	        logger.error(
203	            "Polling circuit opened after %d consecutive target failures; "
204	            "skipping %d remaining target(s)",
205	            consecutive_failures,
206	            skipped,
207	        )
208	        return True
209	
210	    for target_index, target in enumerate(target_list):
211	        payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None
212	        for attempt in range(max_retries + 1):
213	            try:
214	                payload = client.fetch_population_raw(target.area_name)
215	                break
216	            except SeoulAPIError as exc:
217	                if attempt == max_retries:
218	                    logger.error(
219	                        "Hotspot poll failed after %d attempt(s): %s (%s)",
220	                        attempt + 1,
221	                        target.area_name,
222	                        type(exc).__name__,
223	                    )
224	                    break
225	                delay = retry_base_delay_seconds * (2**attempt)
226	                logger.warning(
227	                    "Hotspot poll attempt %d failed; retrying in %.2fs: %s (%s)",
228	                    attempt + 1,
229	                    delay,
230	                    target.area_name,
231	                    type(exc).__name__,
232	                )
233	                sleep(delay)
234	            except Exception as exc:
235	                logger.error(
236	                    "Hotspot fetch failed without retry: %s (%s)",
237	                    target.area_name,
238	                    type(exc).__name__,
239	                )
240	                break
241	
242	        if payload is None:
243	            if record_target_failure(target_index):
244	                break
245	            continue
246	
247	        try:
248	            fetched_at = _as_utc(clock())
249	        except Exception as exc:
250	            logger.error(
251	                "Hotspot fetch timestamp failed: %s (%s)",
252	                target.area_name,
253	                type(exc).__name__,
254	            )
255	            if record_target_failure(target_index):
256	                break
257	            continue
258	
259	        try:
260	            record = build_snapshot_record(
261	                target, payload, fetched_at=fetched_at
262	            )
263	        except Exception as exc:
264	            message = (
265	                "population response target mismatch"
266	                if isinstance(exc, PopulationTargetMismatch)
267	                else "population response validation failed"
268	            )
269	            failure = ParseFailureRecord(
270	                hotspot_id=target.hotspot_id,
271	                fetched_at=fetched_at,
272	                error_type=type(exc).__name__[:255],
273	                error_message=message,
274	                raw_json=payload,
275	            )
276	            try:
277	                save_parse_failure(failure)
278	            except Exception as persistence_exc:
279	                logger.error(
280	                    "Hotspot parse-failure persistence failed: %s (%s)",
281	                    target.area_name,
282	                    type(persistence_exc).__name__,
283	                )
284	            logger.warning(
285	                "Hotspot response parse failed: %s (%s)",
286	                target.area_name,
287	                type(exc).__name__,
288	            )
289	            if record_target_failure(target_index):
290	                break
291	            continue
292	
293	        try:
294	            save_snapshot(record)
295	        except Exception as exc:  # persistence failure must not stop later targets
296	            logger.error(
297	                "Hotspot snapshot persistence failed: %s (%s)",
298	                target.area_name,
299	                type(exc).__name__,
300	            )
301	            if record_target_failure(target_index):
302	                break
303	            continue
304	        saved += 1
305	        consecutive_failures = 0
306	
307	    return PollReport(targets=len(target_list), saved=saved, failed=failed)

37	    def start_cycle(self, *, targets: int, started_at: datetime) -> int:
38	        """Commit a running cycle before any external polling begins."""
39	
40	        with self._session_factory() as session:
41	            cycle = IngestCycle(
42	                started_at=started_at,

44	                saved=0,
45	                failed=0,
46	                status="running",
47	            )
48	            session.add(cycle)

50	            return cycle.id
51	
52	    def finish_cycle(
53	        self,
54	        cycle_id: int,
55	        *,
56	        completed_at: datetime,
57	        saved: int,
58	        failed: int,
59	        status: str,
60	    ) -> None:
61	        """Commit final counters and status for a previously started cycle."""
62	
63	        with self._session_factory() as session:
64	            cycle = session.get(IngestCycle, cycle_id)
65	            if cycle is None:
66	                raise RuntimeError(f"ingest cycle {cycle_id} not found")
67	            cycle.completed_at = completed_at
68	            cycle.saved = saved
69	            cycle.failed = failed
70	            cycle.status = status
71	            session.commit()

73	    @staticmethod
74	    def _snapshot_exists(session: Session, record: SnapshotRecord) -> bool:
75	        snapshot_id = session.scalar(
76	            select(HotspotSnapshot.id).where(
77	                HotspotSnapshot.hotspot_id == record.hotspot_id,
78	                HotspotSnapshot.observed_at == record.observed_at,
79	            )
80	        )
81	        return snapshot_id is not None
82	
83	    def save_snapshot(self, record: SnapshotRecord) -> None:
84	        """Insert one record, treating its natural-key duplicate as a no-op."""
85	
86	        with self._session_factory() as session:
87	            if self._snapshot_exists(session, record):
88	                return
89	
90	            session.add(
91	                HotspotSnapshot(
92	                    hotspot_id=record.hotspot_id,
93	                    observed_at=record.observed_at,
94	                    fetched_at=record.fetched_at,
95	                    congest_level=record.congest_level,
96	                    congest_label=record.congest_label,
97	                    ppltn_min=record.ppltn_min,
98	                    ppltn_max=record.ppltn_max,
99	                    forecast_json=record.forecast_json,
100	                    raw_json=record.raw_json,
101	                )
102	            )
103	            try:
104	                session.commit()
105	            except IntegrityError:
106	                session.rollback()
107	                # Another worker may have inserted the same natural key after
108	                # the preflight query.  Only that race is an idempotent no-op.
109	                if self._snapshot_exists(session, record):
110	                    return
111	                raise
